chapters.name: Unseen Passages (Communicative)
topics: Two unseen passages, up to 750 words, continuous and non-continuous texts from MCB themes (12+10)

chapters.name: Application
topics: Leave, change of subject or section, bus timings; up to 50 words (3)

chapters.name: Factual Description
topics: A person or object, up to 100 words (4)

chapters.name: Formal Letter (Communicative)
topics: Up to 120 words, aligned to MCB topics (7)

chapters.name: Article
topics: Up to 150 words on verbal cues (8)

chapters.name: Grammar (Communicative)
topics: Noun, adverb and relative clauses; determiners
Gap filling 3, editing or omission 4, reordering or transformation 3

chapters.name: Literature Reader
topics: Two of three extracts from prose or poetry (8)
One long answer on values and extrapolation (8)
